title: NudgeForMe - Find missed follow-ups hiding in your sent emails
excerpt: Connect your mailbox. Nudge scans past sent emails, finds quiet conversations, and drafts the next follow-up.
content_html:
How it works

Connect your mailbox. Nudge finds what slipped through.

Most follow-up tools wait for you to create reminders. NudgeForMe starts with the conversations you already sent, then finds the ones that still look unfinished.

STEP 1

Connect your mailbox

Nudge works with all email providers including Gmail, Google Workspace, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Yahoo, iCloud or another IMAP mailbox.

STEP 2

Review missed opportunities

Nudge scans sent conversations and filters for real open loops, like proposals, intros, invoices, approvals, support issues and scheduling threads that never got a reply.

STEP 3

Draft the useful ones

Select one conversation or many. Nudge creates natural follow-up drafts inside your mailbox. You can edit, send, delete or dismiss each one.

Product demo

See NudgeForMe in action.

Watch how NudgeForMe connects to your mailbox, scans sent conversations, finds missed follow-ups, and creates drafts you can review before sending.

You stay in control

Drafts first. Autopilot only when you choose it.

NudgeForMe starts in draft mode. It finds opportunities automatically, but it does not blast every follow-up blindly. You decide what is worth sending.

Prefer more automation? You can enable automatic draft creation later. Nudge still stops watching a thread when someone replies.

Opportunity signal

Proposal - no reply Nudge found an outbound thread where you sent the last meaningful message.

Suggested action

StatusReady to draft

WhyThe conversation appears to be waiting on them

NextSelect, draft, edit and send from your mailbox

Nudge filters noise first. Not every unanswered email deserves another follow-up.

Use cases

It follows up on conversations that still need a response.

Use NudgeForMe for deals, client work, hiring, partnerships, support follow-ups, and small business conversations that quietly go cold.

Sales and founders

Revive quiet deals

Surface proposals, demos, pricing threads, investor intros and partnership conversations that went silent after your last message.

Customer success

Keep customers moving

Follow up on onboarding, renewals, open questions and support issues before they disappear into your sent folder.

Agencies and consultants

Chase approvals politely

Get client feedback, files, sign-offs and invoice updates without manually searching for every unfinished thread.

Recruiters

Unblock hiring conversations

Stay on top of candidate replies, interview scheduling, offer updates and hiring manager decisions.

Pricing

Start free. Upgrade when Nudge becomes part of your workflow.

Review missed opportunities on the free plan, then unlock automation, custom writing controls, and more mailbox capacity with Pro.

Free

$0

For trying Nudge on one mailbox.

  • 1 connected mailbox
  • 100 follow-up draft credits per month
  • 30-day lookback
  • Review missed opportunities
  • Create drafts manually
  • NudgeForMe branding included

Pro

$12/month or $96/year

For people who want Nudge to run follow-up workflows automatically.

  • 3 connected mailboxes
  • 1,000 follow-up draft credits per month
  • Longer lookback
  • Automatically create drafts for due opportunities
  • Optional automatic sending
  • Remove NudgeForMe branding
  • Custom follow-up writing instructions
  • Include previous sent attachments when possible

Built by the Snoooz team, trusted by thousands of email users.

NudgeForMe runs on email infrastructure built by the Snoooz team. It has one focused job: recover missed follow-ups from past sent conversations and help you send the next touch from your own mailbox.

FAQ

Quick answers before you connect your inbox.

Does NudgeForMe send emails automatically?+

New accounts start in draft mode. Nudge creates drafts in your mailbox so you can review, edit, send or delete them. Automatic draft creation is optional and can be changed in settings.

What does Nudge scan?+

Nudge focuses on sent conversations and related thread context. It looks for real open loops where you appear to be waiting on someone else, then filters out noise like completed conversations, obvious no-reply threads and messages that do not need a follow-up.

Which mailboxes are supported?+

Gmail, Google Workspace, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Yahoo, iCloud and other IMAP mailboxes. Gmail and Outlook have the deepest native thread support.

Will it stop after someone replies?+

Yes. Nudge watches for replies and stops following up on that thread when a response is detected.

Can I include the previous email thread?+

Yes. All plans can choose whether drafts include previous thread context. Pro users can also ask Nudge to include attachments from earlier sent messages when possible.

Can I control the writing style?+

Yes. Pro users can add custom writing instructions. All users can choose cadence, block emails or domains, and mark opportunities as good or dismissed so the product learns what is useful.

How do referrals work?+

Share your invite link. Friends get bonus credits when they sign up, and you earn credits when they connect a mailbox and activate Nudge.

Do I need a card to start the Pro trial?+

Launch trials are handled through Stripe so your subscription is created securely. You can manage or cancel billing from NudgeForMe settings before the trial ends.

Is this part of Snoooz?+

NudgeForMe is a separate focused product from the Snoooz team. It shares email infrastructure and experience with Snoooz, but the product is designed specifically for missed follow-ups.

content_html_zh:
它是如何运作的

连接您的邮箱。 轻推发现了漏掉的东西。

大多数后续工具等待您创建提醒。 NudgeForMe 从您已发送的对话开始，然后找到那些看起来尚未完成的对话。

STEP 1

连接您的邮箱

Nudge 适用于所有电子邮件提供商，包括 Gmail、Google Workspace、Outlook、Microsoft 365、Yahoo、iCloud 或其他 IMAP 邮箱。

STEP 2

回顾错过的机会

微移扫描发送的对话和过滤器以查找真正的开放循环，例如提案、介绍、发票、批准、支持问题和从未得到回复的调度线程。

STEP 3

起草有用的

选择一个或多个对话。 Nudge 在您的邮箱内创建自然的后续草稿。 您可以编辑、发送、删除或忽略每一项。

产品演示

查看 NudgeForMe 的实际应用。

观看 NudgeForMe 如何连接到您的邮箱、扫描已发送的对话、查找错过的后续内容以及创建可供您在发送前查看的草稿。

您一切尽在掌握

先打草稿。 仅当您选择时才会自动驾驶。

NudgeForMe 以草稿模式启动。 它会自动发现机会，但不会盲目地轰炸每一个后续。 您决定什么值得发送。

喜欢更多自动化？ 您可以稍后启用自动草稿创建。 当有人回复时，Nudge 仍然会停止观看线程。

机会信号

提案 - 没有回复 Nudge 发现了一个出站线程，您在其中发送了最后一条有意义的消息。

建议采取的行动

状态准备起草

为什么对话似乎正在等待他们

下一步选择、起草、编辑并从您的邮箱发送

微移首先过滤噪音。 并非每封未回复的电子邮件都值得再次跟进。

使用案例

它会跟进仍需要回应的对话。

使用 NudgeForMe 进行交易、客户工作、招聘、合作伙伴关系、支持跟进以及悄然冷落的小型企业对话。

销售和创始人

恢复平静的交易

表面上的提案、演示、定价线索、投资者介绍和合作伙伴对话在您发出最后一条消息后就陷入了沉默。

客户成功

让客户感动

跟进入职、续订、未决问题和支持问题，以免它们消失在您的已发送文件夹中。

机构和顾问

礼貌地寻求批准

获取客户反馈、文件、签核和发票更新，无需手动搜索每个未完成的线程。

招聘人员

解锁招聘对话

随时了解候选人的回复、面试安排、招聘信息更新和招聘经理的决定。

定价

开始免费。 当 Nudge 成为您工作流程的一部分时进行升级。

查看免费计划中错过的机会，然后使用 Pro 解锁自动化、自定义写作控件和更多邮箱容量。

由 Snoooz 团队构建，受到数千名电子邮件用户的信任。

NudgeForMe 在 Snoooz 团队构建的电子邮件基础设施上运行。 它有一个重点工作：从过去发送的对话中恢复错过的后续内容，并帮助您从自己的邮箱发送下一次联系。

FAQ

连接收件箱之前快速获得答案。

Does NudgeForMe send emails automatically?+

新帐户以草稿模式启动。 Nudge 在您的邮箱中创建草稿，以便您可以查看、编辑、发送或删除它们。 自动草稿创建是可选的，可以在设置中更改。

What does Nudge scan?+

Nudge 专注于发送的对话和相关的线程上下文。 它会寻找真正的开环，即您似乎在等待其他人，然后过滤掉噪音，例如已完成的对话、明显的无回复线程和不需要跟进的消息。

Which mailboxes are supported?+

Gmail、Google Workspace、Outlook、Microsoft 365、Yahoo、iCloud 和其他 IMAP 邮箱。 Gmail 和 Outlook 拥有最深入的本机线程支持。

Will it stop after someone replies?+

是的。 Nudge 会监视回复，并在检测到响应时停止跟进该线程。

Can I include the previous email thread?+

是的。 所有计划都可以选择草稿是否包含先前的线程上下文。 专业版用户还可以要求 Nudge 在可能的情况下包含之前发送的消息中的附件。

Can I control the writing style?+

是的。 专业用户可以添加自定义书写说明。 所有用户都可以选择节奏、阻止电子邮件或域，并将机会标记为良好或拒绝，以便产品了解什么是有用的。

How do referrals work?+

分享您的邀请链接。 朋友在注册时会获得奖励积分，而您在他们连接邮箱并激活 Nudge 时会获得积分。

Do I need a card to start the Pro trial?+

启动试用是通过 Stripe 处理的，因此您的订阅是安全创建的。 在试用结束之前，您可以通过 NudgeForMe 设置管理或取消计费。

Is this part of Snoooz?+

NudgeForMe 是 Snoooz 团队的一款独立的专注产品。 它与 Snoooz 共享电子邮件基础设施和经验，但该产品是专门为错过的跟进而设计的。
